tool.name: tba
tool.description: : reference-free multiple alignment of pairwise MAFs (multiz TBA)
tool.command: ## Galaxy flattens newlines in <command>, so the work is a POSIX sh script with argv inputs, ## never Cheetah, so the exact same script runs as a dev UDT. ## Backticks (never \$(...)) and bare \$var (never \${var}) keep XML->UDT conversion 1-to-1. sh '$script' '$tree' '$output' '$pairwise' '$sequences' '#if $sequence_ids then $sequence_ids else ""#' '#if $pairwise_ids then $pairwise_ids else ""#' '#if $species_map then $species_map else ""#'

param.name: pairwise
param.label: Pairwise MAFs
param.help: All N*(N-1) ordered pairwise reciprocal-best MAFs (both A.B and B.A directions), sorted by target coordinate. May already have species.sequence row names, or bare sequence names when pairwise_ids is supplied.

param.name: sequences
param.label: Species FASTA sequences
param.help: One genome FASTA per species in the guide tree. May already have species.sequence headers, or bare headers when sequence_ids is supplied.

param.name: tree
param.label: Species guide tree
param.help: Rooted Newick tree giving the TBA merge order (branch lengths and internal labels are stripped). Every leaf must be a letter followed by letters, digits or _, without maf or eof.

param.name: sequence_ids
param.label: Species FASTA element identifiers
param.help: Optional newline-delimited element identifiers in the same order as the FASTA collection (from collection_element_identifiers). Enables in-job prefixing of unprefixed FASTA headers.

param.name: pairwise_ids
param.label: Pairwise MAF element identifiers
param.help: Optional newline-delimited pair identifiers in the same order as the pairwise MAF collection (sp1__sp2, sp1.sp2, or sp1_sp2). Enables in-job prefixing of unprefixed MAF s-lines by row position.

param.name: species_map
param.label: Identifier-to-species map (2-column TSV)
param.help: Optional 2-column TSV (collection_id TAB tree_leaf_name) mapping raw identifiers (such as NCBI accessions containing dots like GCA_032713075.1) to TBA-safe leaf names in the guide tree.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Runs ``tba`` (Threaded Blockset Aligner from `multiz`_) to build a reference-free multiple genome alignment from all ``N * (N - 1)`` ordered pairwise reciprocal-best MAF alignments, species FASTA assemblies, and a rooted Newick guide tree::
tba + T=$tmp "$tree" *.*.sing.maf out.maf
**Two input modes**
1. **Unprefixed collections (recommended for Galaxy workflows):** Pass ``sequence_ids`` and ``pairwise_ids`` from Galaxy's *Extract element identifiers* tool (``collection_element_identifiers``), plus an optional 2-column ``species_map`` TSV (``collection_id<TAB>tree_leaf_name``) when identifiers contain dots (such as NCBI accessions like ``GCA_032713075.1``). Unprefixed FASTA headers and pairwise MAF ``s`` lines are prefixed with ``<species>.`` on the fly inside the job with GNU ``gawk`` and zero intermediate datasets. 2. **Pre-prefixed inputs (fallback):** Omit ``sequence_ids`` and ``pairwise_ids`` when FASTAs and MAFs already carry ``<species>.<sequence>`` prefixes.
.. warning:: ``tba`` splits MAF filenames and ``s``-line names on ``.``, requires species names to begin with a letter (``[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*``), and filters ``maf``/``eof``. Pairwise MAFs must be sorted by target coordinate; unsorted inputs and missing ordered pairs are rejected up front.
.. _multiz: https://github.com/multiz/multiz
